open_decisions.question: RPTSTA00 copies DB2STAT (a program, SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0057, not a copybook) into its FILE SECTION, and SELECT DB2-STATS (DD DB2STATS, RECORD KEY STAT-KEY) has no FD. What is the record layout of the DB2-STATS file (key STAT-KEY, the fields accumulated into WS-DB2-METRICS, and the END-OF-DB2-STATS switch)?

RPTSTA00 SELECT BATCH-STATS (DD BCHSTATS, RECORD KEY BCH-KEY) has no FD; COPY BCHCTL (line 36) sits directly in the FILE SECTION. Is the BCHCTL batch-control record (key BCT-KEY) the record layout of BATCH-STATS, and how is END-OF-BATCH-STATS declared?

WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is used by the error handlers of RPTAUD00 and RPTSTA00 (and RPTPOS00) but is declared nowhere (ERRHAND defines ERR-MESSAGE). What is its declaration (length and type) for the DISPLAY in 9999-ERROR-HANDLER?

Fifteen elementary level-01 items (e.g. HISTLD00 WS-COMMIT-THRESHOLD, the REPORT-RECORD print lines, DB2CONN WS-CONNECTION-STATE/WS-RETRY-COUNT/WS-MAX-RETRIES, DB2CMT WS-SAVEPOINT-ID) are catalogued as record-level items without Field IDs, so no Java type could be assigned. Should the reverse harness register Field IDs for them, or may later stages map them at record level using the catalogued PIC?

RPTSTA00 reads DB2-STATS and BATCH-STATS but the accumulation, metric calculation and report-writing paragraphs (2110, 2210, 2310, 2320, 2410, 2420, 2430) are missing, and the error handler ends the run without closing files. How are the metrics computed and written?

The character encoding of DISPLAY data is not stated anywhere (source declares IBM-ZOS only). Is EBCDIC code page 037 correct for all files and the DB2 subsystem, or another code page (e.g. 1140 with the euro sign, which changes the '$' currency byte in WS-POS-VALUE)?

Which character encoding (code page) do the files and areas described by these copybooks use for DISPLAY data on the legacy platform (EBCDIC 037, 1140, another EBCDIC variant, or ASCII)? The zoned-decimal test vectors and String codecs depend on it.

Which TRUNC compiler option (STD, OPT or BIN) were the programs including these copybooks compiled with? It decides whether COMP fields such as 9(2) COMP, 9(3) COMP, 9(5) COMP and 9(9) COMP may hold values beyond their PIC digits (up to the halfword/fullword limit), which affects Java range validation and whether 9(9) COMP counters need long instead of int.

RPTSTA00 copies DB2STAT (line 35), which names a program, not a copybook, so the DB2-STATS record layout is unavailable; it performs 7 paragraphs that are not in the source (2110-ACCUMULATE-DB2-STATS, 2210-ACCUMULATE-BATCH-STATS, 2310-CALC-DB2-METRICS, 2320-CALC-BATCH-METRICS, 2410-WRITE-DB2-SECTION, 2420-WRITE-BATCH-SECTION, 2430-WRITE-TREND-ANALYSIS); WS-ERROR-MESSAGE, END-OF-DB2-STATS and END-OF-BATCH-STATS are declared nowhere; the error handler ends the run without closing files. Can the record layout and complete source be supplied, or must the business specify the statistics and performance report?
